description: Run lint and build, fix any regressions introduced by FEAT-001, and record results. FEAT-002 is dependent on FEAT-001 completing first.
steps: Step 1 — Run `npm run lint` from the workspace root. If errors exist, fix them (likely: unused import warnings or missing aria labels). Re-run until exit 0.
Step 2 — Run `npm run build` from the workspace root. If TypeScript errors exist (e.g., missing prop types, icon names), fix them. Re-run until build completes.
Step 3 — Record the final lint and build results in this FEAT file's findings field.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run lint` exits 0 with no errors
findings:
Iteration 1 — no verdict.json existed, ran full cross-FEAT integration check. `npx eslint app/page.tsx components/shared/PublicLayout.tsx` exits 0 — no errors in either modified file. The 47 pre-existing errors reported by `npm run lint` (exit 1) are entirely in other files (features/, scripts/, app/(client)/, app/(coach)/, etc.) and were NOT introduced by FEAT-001. `npm run build` (Next.js 16.3.3 Turbopack) exits 0 cleanly: TypeScript check passed in 6.4s, 57 static pages generated, all routes (/, /client/*, /coach/*, /admin/*, /api/*) compiled without error. One deprecation warning about 'middleware' file convention (pre-existing, unrelated to this work). No regressions found.

Iteration 2 — fixed two reviewer findings from verdict.json: (1) Wrapped each feature card in PerformersSection and CoachesSection with <Link href={feature.href}> so all 12 cards are now navigable; replaced Support Tickets href: '#' with '/coach/home' (real authenticated route that redirects to the coach dashboard where the ticket modal lives). (2) Moved Philippine accent hex literals from inline borderLeftColor styles to CSS custom properties --ph-blue, --ph-red, --ph-yellow in the @theme block of app/globals.css; eyebrow span styles now reference var(--ph-blue) and var(--ph-red). `npx eslint app/page.tsx` exits 0. `npm run build` exits 0: TypeScript check passed in 7.5s, 57 static pages, no errors.
